source:
@@U02240@@
and except for the fact that we owe them wages, they'd long ago have deserted us. Forbid them what they all demand and you might as well stick your head in a hornet’s nest. The empire they swore to defend to the last man, they themselves plunder and lay waste from end to end, and their savage rioting proceeds unchecked. Already half our world lies in ruin, and surrounding kingdoms say it’s no concern of theirs.

@@U02242@@
So much for allies! The subsidies they pledged come through like water from a well run dry. Besides, Sire, in the vastness of your empire whose hands has property fallen into? Go anywhere and you find a new proprietor has moved in who is very protective of his independence. And what do we do? All we can: stand passively by and watch him getting on. We've given away so many rights, we've no right left for ourselves. And as for parties, as they're called, there’s no relying on them. Whether they love you, hate you, praise you, chide you, it means nothing anymore. The Guelfs and the Ghibellines are laying low right now, resting up from their latest encounter. Who today cares about helping his neighbor? Me and mine is their only concern. Where’s the gold? The gates to it are barricaded. Everyone scratching and scraping for anything they can get. And still our treasury is empty.
translation:
@@U02240@@
如果不是我们欠他们工资，他们早就抛弃了我们。如果禁止他们的要求，那你还不如把头埋进马蜂窝。他们发誓要保卫到最后一人的帝国，他们自己却从头到尾进行掠夺和蹂躏，他们的野蛮暴动肆无忌惮。我们的世界已经有一半变成了废墟，周围的王国表示这与他们无关。

@@U02242@@
对于盟友来说就这么多了！他们承诺的补贴就像井里的水一样落实到位。再说了，陛下，在您幅员辽阔的帝国里，财产落入了谁的手里呢？走到任何地方，你都会发现一位新业主搬了进来，他非常保护自己的独立性。我们该怎么办？我们只能：被动地站在一边，看着他继续前进。我们已经放弃了太多的权利，我们自己已经没有任何权利了。至于政党，正如他们所说的那样，没有什么可以依赖的。无论他们爱你、恨你、赞美你、责备你，都已经没有任何意义了。圭尔夫派和吉伯林派目前处于低调状态，正在从最近的遭遇中休息。今天谁关心帮助他的邻居？我和我的是他们唯一关心的。金子在哪里？它的大门被封锁了。每个人都在努力争取任何他们能得到的东西。但我们的国库仍然是空的。
